teaches: a written shadda on a word-final yaa with no trailing taa marbuta, PLUS attested nisba base-category evidence, is the nisba/relational classifier -- the class label carries no case, mood or governor
the same geminated yaa followed by a written taa marbuta is the DISTINCT abstract-noun classifier
the SAME word-final geminated-yaa shape, with attested non-nisba-adjective base-category evidence instead, resolves to the distinct faʿīl-pattern adjective classifier -- never to nisba
an unmarked (unvocalised) surface carries no shadda evidence; normalisation is never treated as confirmation
missing shadda evidence entirely still abstains, never a default nisba survivor

قَوِيّ honestly carries the SAME word-final geminated-yaa shape as a nisba (a near-collision faʿīl-pattern adjective, not a nisba or abstract noun); shape and written shadda alone never decide the rival -- without declared base_category_evidence this abstains instead of defaulting to nisba
an ordinary taa-marbuta noun with no geminated yaa at all is not swept into the abstract-noun class by the taa marbuta alone
an arbitrary/unattested base_category_evidence value never fabricates identity for either rival -- only the two closed-vocabulary attested values resolve anything
